interface.reason: Chat lists, settings, profiles, search, message text and app chrome use canonical rose text on dark surfaces.

messages.reason: Dark incoming/outgoing bubbles, selection, replies, links, metadata and media controls are colour-mapped.

controls.reason: Composer, menus, dialogs, attachment and emoji panel chrome, focus-colour hooks and translucent selectors are mapped.

wallpaper.reason: Two existing dark surface roles produce a static Android wallpaper and a 1×2 Desktop RGB background.

typography.reason: Telegram owns family, weight, size and line metrics; bold keeps the text role.

geometry.reason: Native theme formats expose colours, not square radii, border widths, focus-ring shapes or spacing.

motion.reason: Telegram controls motion and reduced-motion preferences; no animated wallpaper is emitted.

content-data.reason: Photos, videos, user accents, chart data and Premium/story artwork remain host content.

developer-surfaces.reason: This interface port has no terminal palette, diagnostic/diff model or hued syntax opt-in.

primitives.reason: Only semantic role mappings are eligible for delivery.
